answer: Entry is bound to one numbered survey pillar on a mapped ridge vertex. Only that holder may bolt a uniquely serialled ferrous collar to the pillar and, at an unannounced sun-window, flash a sealed registrar mirror into the official receiving hut. Inspectors match collar stamp, mirror lot, pillar log, and the hut plate. A shared pillar, a borrowed mirror, or an off-window flash is forfeited as one farm. Minting N aliases requires N exclusive vertices, N unique ferrous collars, and N live flashes no single crew can cover in the same hour.
